label: Breaking News: Lift Mission Sabotaged by Spy!

lines.text: The United Forces of Humanity and the Goddess Squad have made multiple attempts to reclaim the Lift, but all have ended in failure.
Reports suggest those repeated failures may be due to internal leaks.
In other words, there could be a spy within the United Forces of Humanity!
The Lift is heavily defended by the Raptures, making any assault extremely difficult. Even so, the fact that not even the Goddess Squad has succeeded has raised serious questions.
If a spy is involved, it would explain everything.
Countless soldiers and Nikkes are being sent to their deaths because of someone working to protect the Lift from within!
A human traitor is feeding intel to the Raptures!
What could possibly be inside the Lift that's worth hiding at all costs?
People, it's time to wake up.
We can't keep placing blind trust in the United Forces of Humanity.
We have to find the spy!
